explanation: For y1=e^{2x} and y2=e^{3x}, W=e^{5x}. Variation of parameters gives u1=-∫2x dx=-x² and u2=∫2xe^{-x}dx=-2(x+1)e^{-x}. Thus yp=-(x²+2x+2)e^{2x}. Absorbing -2e^{2x} into the homogeneous term gives g=-(x²+2x)e^{2x}, option a. Verification: with v=-x²-2x, g''-5g'+6g=e^{2x}(v''-v')=2xe^{2x}.
